{
    "content": "<p>Sometimes it's helpful to see exactly what your CQW is receiving. Put this into\na style and see what properties and data you're receiving:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-xslt\">&lt;xsl:for-each select=&quot;@*&quot;&gt;\n    P:&lt;xsl:value-of select=&quot;name()&quot; /&gt;&lt;br/&gt;\n    V:&lt;xsl:value-of select=&quot;.&quot; /&gt;&lt;br/&gt;\n&lt;/xsl:for-each&gt;\n</code></pre>\n",
